title: Labour–Fabian public register
tagline: An unofficial directory of Labour politicians, former office-holders, peers, donors and other public figures with a published Fabian Society link.
methodologyNote: A person is listed only when a named Fabian role, an explicit membership statement, a donation to the Society, or a published pamphlet, essay or similar output can be cited from a public page. Former MPs, ministers, mayors, MSPs, Senedd members, peers and other public figures are included on the same evidence test as sitting office-holders. Authorship of a Fabian pamphlet, without a named role or membership statement, is labelled separately and is not treated as proof of membership. Ordinary private members are not listed.
limitations: This is not an official Fabian Society or Labour Party register. It does not claim to list every member.
The Society’s 2024–25 annual report said 141 Fabian MPs were elected in 2024. That list has not been published. Names are not inferred from the total.
Former office-holders and other public figures are included only where a published Fabian link can be cited. Leaving office does not remove a sourced record.
A pamphlet, essay or conference listing is not treated as proof of membership unless the source also names a role or states membership.
A donation to the Labour Party is not a donation to the Fabian Society. Society gifts are recorded only where the Society or the Electoral Commission names them.
Wikipedia is used only as a lead. Every fact on a person page cites a non-Wikipedia URL.
Government, parliamentary and Society pages change. Each source records the date it was checked.
